name: Tina Shadix Roddenbery
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: University of Georgia School of Law
about: Tina Shadix Roddenbery is a distinguished attorney at Boyd Collar Nolen Tuggle & Roddenbery in Atlanta, Georgia. A board-certified specialist in family law by the National Board of Trial Advocacy, she brings 38 years of experience to every matter – from divorce and custody disputes to paternity actions and post-judgment modifications.

A native of Georgia, Ms. Roddenbery graduated cum laude in 1984 with an A.B.J. from the University of Georgia, Athens, and earned her J.D. from the University of Georgia School of Law in 1987. Admitted to the State Bar of Georgia that same year, she quickly established herself as a trusted advocate and strategist in the courtroom and beyond.

Throughout her career, Ms. Roddenbery has held numerous leadership roles within Georgia’s legal community. She is a fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers and served as master of the Charles Longstreet Weltner Family Law Inn of Court. As chair of the State Bar of Georgia’s Family Law Section, she guided policy and professional standards, and as a trustee and executive committee member of the Board of Trustees for the Institute of Continuing Judicial Education, she helped shape mandatory training for Georgia’s judges. She has also chaired the Commission on Continuing Lawyer Competency, ensuring that attorneys maintain the highest level of professional skill.

A sought-after speaker and author, Ms. Roddenbery regularly presents at continuing-education seminars across the state and has co-authored key family law legislation. In addition to her extensive trial record, she is a fully trained mediator and late-case evaluator, adept at facilitating settlement before trial.

Ms. Roddenbery’s competence has been cited by CNN and other national media outlets seeking authoritative commentary on family law issues. Rated “Superb” on Avvo, she has also been selected to all the Georgia Super Lawyers lists – named a Top 5 Family Law attorney in 2026 (and the only woman included), ranked among the Top 50 Women from 2009 to 2016 and 2018 to2026, listed as a Top 10 attorney in 2022 and from 2024 to 2026, and included in the Top 100 from 2021 to 2026.
